notes: RND-327 implementation itself passes all functional ACs (1-3, 5). However, working tree contains RND-328 deliverables (admin_audit_page.py, audit_log.html, test_audit_page.py) which violates the parallel wave file ownership contract. Per AC-4, sidenav.py must remain untouched AND all changes must belong to single RND. Human intervention required to: (1) stash/branch RND-328 changes, (2) re-run QA with clean RND-327-only tree, (3) verify RND-327 isolation before merge approval. This is critical for preventing conflicts in Wave-4 parallel tracks (RND-327/328/329/330).
